agent_action: Raise ambiguous requirements to coordinator and continue independent work.
message_tool: t3_thread_send mode=steer; this is internal coordination, not external messaging
coordinator_action: Resolve from existing user instructions/evidence where possible; for a consequential unresolved user preference ask request_user_input_async and continue independent work.
not_user_votes: Routine parameters already delegated to analyst judgement
while_pending: Keep alternatives or a clearly provisional assumption. Do not treat elapsed time or silence as approval. Do not publish dependent assertions as established.
when_answered: Record exact answer/provenance, notify responsible active tasks and rerun affected work only.
boundaries: No new permissions for paid services, external messages, booking, publication or restarts.
